Subject: Final invoice & VAT attestation for Redwood renewal (Greenleaf)

Hi Hannah / Karthik,

Thanks again — Greenleaf is ready to settle the renewal and the contract true‑up. Attached are the PO and our VAT attestation for your records. Summary below: 

- Renewal term: 2028-09-01 to 2029-08-31
- Previously invoiced: $420,000 USD
- True‑up due at renewal (usage delta): $58,320 USD
- VAT jurisdiction: Ireland (valid VAT # attached)

We need a final invoice addressed to Greenleaf Analytics, PO# 4578, and wire instructions or EU entity invoice details we can use for domestic payment. Can you confirm whether Redwood will invoice the EU subsidiary (Redwood Ireland Ltd) or the US parent? If you invoice the US entity we will need VAT reverse‑charge documentation.

Attachments: Greenleaf_PO_4578.pdf, Greenleaf_VAT_Attestation.pdf

Best,
Emily Jenkins
Head of Finance, Greenleaf Analytics
emily.jenkins@greenleaf.com

Date: 2028-09-03T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Final invoice & VAT attestation for Redwood renewal (Greenleaf)

Thanks Emily — looping in Marcus from Finance to confirm invoice entity and wire details.

Karthik / Marcus: quick asks so we can get this paid without delay: 
1) Can Finance issue the final invoice from Redwood Ireland Ltd to avoid cross‑border withholding?
2) If we must invoice the US parent, can we provide the VAT reverse‑charge wording? Emily attached their VAT attestation which should suffice.
3) Any preferred memo for the wire to help AP match the PO (PO# 4578 + INV#)?

I can also provide a DocuSign for the amendment if Finance needs a signed acceptance before sending the invoice.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Emily Jenkins <emily.jenkins@greenleaf.com>
Date: 2028-09-04T09:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Final invoice & VAT attestation for Redwood renewal (Greenleaf)

Putting my preference on record: invoice from Redwood Ireland Ltd is ideal — it reduces friction for EU AP teams. Marcus, can you draft the invoice from the Ireland entity and include the PO# and the true‑up line? If we can attach the usage report (week‑by‑week) that helps their reconciliation.

Emily — we will produce an invoice (RDW‑INV) and send wire instructions for an EU bank transfer. If Greenleaf prefers to pay via ACH to the US entity instead, note that VAT will need explicit reverse‑charge confirmation; please confirm which path you want.

Also thinking of escrow routing for the true‑up in case finance needs payment hold for audit — Vanessa, any objections to instructing Greenleaf to put the true‑up into our short‑term escrow account pending recon?

Thanks — Karthik
